description:
The same daily devotional, SPOKEN — for members who would rather listen, or who read little. Returns audio URLs alongside the text. Requires an API key (speech costs money per character).
Language: pass a consent_token with the 'context:read' scope and the member's own preferred language is used, so you need not ask them; or pass `language` explicitly for a one-off. If SoapBox has no voice for that language the tool says so and returns text only — it will NOT read the devotional in the wrong voice.
SCRIPTURE IS ALWAYS SPOKEN IN ENGLISH (KJV) and its `translatable` flag is false. SoapBox never machine-translates Scripture and this API serves the public-domain KJV only. Never translate the verse yourself and never pass a translated verse back in.
For a non-English member this is a TWO-STEP call: step 1 returns `translate_this` (our framing prose only — the opening, the reflection questions and the prayer prompt); translate just that into their language and call again with the same date and reference plus `reflection_text`, and you get both audio files back. For an English member one call returns the whole thing.

consent_token.description: Optional SoapBox consent token with the 'context:read' scope, which lets the devotional be spoken in the member's own preferred language without asking them. Omit it and the tool falls back to `language`, then to English. An invalid, expired or wrong-scope token returns an authorization error.

date.description: The day to build the devotional for, as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

format.description: Audio container for the returned files.

gender.description: Optional preferred voice gender for the framing prose.

language.description: Optional language for the framing prose, as a language code (not a locale is fine: 'es', 'pt-BR', 'zh-Hans'). Overrides the member's profile. Scripture stays English regardless.

reference.description: Optional: use this passage instead of the season's selection.

reflection_text.description: Step 2 of a non-English devotional: YOUR translation of the `translate_this` text returned by step 1. Must contain only the framing prose — never a translated Bible verse.

name: get_audio_devotional
